family: T_q: q leaves at C plus C--A--B
limitations: Finite q range only. This does not establish the whole subdivided-star family, exclude arbitrary trees, or prove the universal source conjecture.
local_derivative_bound: ||d |phi_s><phi_s|/ds|| = s+sqrt(1+s^2) < 5/2; the certificate uses L=5(q+2)/2 for each ordered eigenvalue.
logical_scope: A zero of the actual strict margin forces one of the enumerated resultants to vanish. Every such interior root has a neighborhood with positive actual margin, and the reference margin is positive; continuity excludes a zero anywhere in (0,1).
method: exact QQ[t,x] charge-spin characteristic polynomials; exact crossing resultants and exact VAS continued-fraction real-root isolation; rational root enclosures; Weyl continuity bound around every interior resultant root; one exact reference sign per q
zero_eigenvalue_exclusion: The all-zero computational state has Rayleigh quotient q+2 for K_s, so the top root minus a stripped zero root exceeds 1-t.
